Some unknown assailants have reportedly stabbed Monica Mary, a 21-year-old 300-level student of Westland University, Iwo, Osun State, to death, causing panic among students and other residents of the town. Sources in the Agbowo area of Iwo, where Mary had taken up accommodation, who preferred anonymity for security reasons, told PUNCH Metro during a telephone interview on Wednesday that the incident occurred around 11:30 pm on Tuesday. It was also gathered that Mary had been residing on the university campus until recently, when she took up accommodation in the Agbowo area, where she eventually met her untimely death. A resident of Agbowo, who spoke with our correspondent on the matter, further said, “She was murdered around her hostel at about 11:32 pm in Agbowo, Iwo. “Someone said she heard her noise when the incident happened, but no one could come out. She had gone out to charge her mobile phone. She was a calm girl and did not get into trouble. Make PUNCH part of your everyday experience. The matter was reported to the police at Iwo Division, but the entire student community in the town is in a state of panic over the incident.” Osun losing mineral wealth to informal mining, raw exports – NEPC Osun urges residents to patronise locally made goods Evening recap: Tinubu receives state police bill, NLC, TUC settle allowance dispute, other top stories When contacted, the spokesperson for the Osun State Police Command, Abiodun Ojelabi, confirmed the incident. Ojelabi said operatives had visited the scene of the crime and assured that the perpetrators would be apprehended soon. He said, “We received the report of the murder of Monica Mary, a student of Westland University, Iwo, this morning. On arrival, we examined the area and the corpse, and a cut was discovered on her neck. It was suspected to be a knife wound. “We got information that she went to charge her phone and was returning when the incident happened. She had been living on campus since she gained admission to the university. She just moved off campus this semester. “We recovered a knife, a phone pouch and other items. The Commissioner of Police has directed that the Criminal Investigation Department take over the case. Investigation is ongoing, and the parents are ready to support the police.” Bola Bamigbola
